title: Irrationalité de $\zeta(2)$ et $\zeta(3)$
note: Astérisque 61 (1979), Journées Arithmétiques de Luminy (1978), Soc. Math. France, 11-13 (NUMDAM AST_1979__61__11_0; pre-DOI volume). Establishes irrationality of zeta(3) and re-proves irrationality of zeta(2) via three-term Holonomic recurrences beating lcm(1..n)^3 and lcm(1..n)^2 denominator growth.
